passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: M.S. Mobile Home Movers Inc. Established: Michael operated a mobile-home moving business known as M.S. Mobile Home Movers Inc.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: MS Mobile Home Movers Inc. held a license #2705040949 with the Virginia Contractors License Board, expiring on 08-31-2003.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Family Friend Visits the Shorts: Family friend Sheila Davis stopped by the Short residence to drop off payment for work Michael had completed. Davis recalled that what was intended to be a brief 15-minute visit turned into approximately an hour of conversation with the family.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Davis later described Michael and Mary as hardworking, close to Jennifer and devoted to spending time together as a family.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Mary regularly helped Michael with his mobile-home moving work, including unloading cinder blocks.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael and Mary rarely used a babysitter because, according to Davis, they preferred spending their free time with Jennifer.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Short Family Planned Move to Callaway: Michael and Mary Short were planning to move back to Callaway, Virginia, where Mary had grown up.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael and Mary Short operated M.S. Mobile Home Movers, a business that moved mobile homes.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The Short family was considering relocating to South Carolina. As part of that possibility, Michael traveled to areas of South Carolina seeking employment.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Bennettsville, South Carolina

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Florence, South Carolina

passages.text: Conway, South Carolina

passages.text: Investigators later specifically identified the areas around:

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Those trips would become important enough that investigators traveled to South Carolina eight years after the murders to locate and interview people who may have interacted with Michael there.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Jennifer completed third grade.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: She spent considerable time with her parents and frequently accompanied Michael on nonschool days while he worked.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Jennifer turned 9 on July 12, 2002.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Her parents bought school supplies and children’s clothing to prepare for the upcoming school year.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Jennifer celebrated her 9th birthday.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Jennifer was enrolled to return to Figsboro Elementary School for fourth grade.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Investigators have subsequently identified this two-week period as particularly important.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Authorities continue to seek anyone who had contact with Michael, Mary or Jennifer Short between August 1 and August 14, 2002.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: They also want information from anyone whose mobile home Michael’s company moved during 2002 and who investigators have never interviewed.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael continued making trips to South Carolina while the family considered relocating.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael and Mary took a concrete step toward leaving their Henry County home.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: The Shorts contacted real estate agent Marlene Dalton and asked her to put their house up for sale.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: Michael reportedly explained that his business was slow and that the family had a mobile home where they could live temporarily.

passages.section: Short Family Murder and Abduction Timeline
passages.text: An open house was scheduled for Sunday, August 18, 2002, three days after Michael and Mary were found murdered and Jennifer disappeared.
